data.description:
BATTLE AS MORTALS. RISE AS A GOD.

Become the next great Asgardian god as you immerse yourself in the legendary world of Norse mythology. Sharpen your swordplay and bring your own fighting style into the fray with next-level combat. Possess different classes of mortal heroes, solve larger-than-life puzzles, and transform animals into warrior companions that you lead into battle.

Answer the call, Asgardian. God-scale VR awaits!

changelog.change_log:
NEW
---
New Server Update - Favors have been reset.

NEW
----
Localization support for French, German, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, and Korean

Added a “keys found” label on the world map to show what’s been discovered in each location. Note that we did not track this information previously, so it only works for new keys found after the update has been installed.

 
FIXES
-----
Updated waveworks .dll. This fixed a crash related to rendering water for anyone with a CPU that has a high number of cores.

Fixed inconsistency between behavior and description of 'Asgard Faerie Blessing' throughout the game.

Fixed the 'World Tree Codex' title overlap when opening the Codex in 'Aegir's Hall'

The words 'block' and 'basic' lacked a space in the Rage Tutorial's description in the main menu's tutorial section

Mortal heroes and followers' lighting was inconsistent during 'Fallen Spirit' arenas in 'Asgardian Basecamp' and 'Skadi's Island'

Fixed partial invisible collision present in doorways leading to elevators of 'Guard's Wing' checkpoint in 'Skadi's Island'

Player was unable to greet follower after transmuting the shark, placing him on island and removing bridge at 'Stormborn Beach'

Progress was blocked when holding one of 'Thor's Bolt Cores' in close proximity to its slot and reloading the application in the 'Valley of Trials'

'Sveinn' and 'Valdorf' disappeared after finishing 'Thor's Vow' quest and traveling back to the 'Tavern'

The player was unable to buy more than 45 'Barbed bolts' from 'Sindri' in 'Aegir's Hall'

'Niflheim key' disappeared when progressing to the 'Pit of despair' checkpoint and traveling to Asgard in 'Infested Waters'

Thor's IGC fails to trigger if user opens the menu during final elevator descent in 'Skadi's Island'

Siggi failed to seize key nearest to the locked gate after reaching 'River Cavern' and reloading level in 'Gjoll, River of the Dead'

User fell through an elevator while standing on the right edge of the asset going up from the 'Holding Cells' checkpoint at 'Skadi's Island'

Often, 'Bjornhild' would fail to bring the log with her while using the teleporter near the god altar in 'River's End' in the 'River Isle' map

'The mark' was missing from its cell when returning from an 'Online Arena' at the 'End of the Line' side quest area in 'Borgarholt Fort'

Progression could be blocked after Siggi retrieves a key and the user is out of reach to retrieve it in 'The Virgin's Labyrinth'

General performance improvements.

* Full left handed support. The previous “Pointer Hand” setting has been merged into this feature. In game functions now swap handedness – ie you move with the right thumbstick when this option is enabled.
* Faster load times after death.
* Fix for graphics settings getting reverted back to low after relaunching the title.
* Fix for unsupported in-game text if the PC language was set to Japanese. Localization is still coming!
* Fixed the exploit that allowed players to move the hero with god totem pieces.
* Bug fixes:
* Rarely, user's friend's account for fallen hero challenges can appear repeatedly after being avenged in same level throughout the title
* Progression is blocked as gear appears missing when the user reloads checkpoint after placing the second gear in the 'Tongue-Tied' side-quest in 'Forgotten Sanctum'
* Progression Blocker occurs when User exits Ask and Embla’s Resting place without approaching the tombs in 'Forgotten Sanctum'
* Progress is blocked as Hulda becomes unresponsive when reloading after transmuting the turtle and then entering the 'Tomb of Thorketil the Patient' in 'Stormborn Beach'
* Inconsistent lighting is seen on the ground and the surrounding assets once gaining control of the fledgeling god in the 'Bifrost'
* User is able to transform into the god form of the first god altar from the 'Stormborn Beach' checkpoint before converting into the god mode from 'Stormborn Battlefield' in 'Stormborn Beach'
* God beacon is absent when activating the The Old Keep's 'God Altar' then fast-travelling to Asgard and fast-travelling back to the 'Hel's Old Keep' travel stone in 'The Old Keep'
* 'Quest Book' entries are missing follower icons when the user observes multiple sidequests based in the 'Halls of the Dead'
* 'Quest Book' entries are missing Follower icons when the user observes multiple sidequests based in 'The Old Keep'
* Sometimes, application may return to Oculus Dash and hang when transitioning to loading screen
* Haptic feedback fails to restore after closing menu while on moving elevator throughout the title
* Music doesn't play when entering final boss battle from Tavern
* Required follower icons for side quests 'A Giant Mystery', 'Violent Vermin' and 'Tangled Trouble' are absent when opening the quest in the 'Quest Book' at 'Asgardian Basecamp'
* User becomes stuck after climbing on and then dashing over a broken catapult in 'Borgarholt Village'
* User can become stuck in invisible collision when walking near a wall close to the Fiery Vaettir in 'Stormborn Beach'
* Progress becomes blocked when the user quits the application during screen fade out to 'Hvergelmir Passage' from 'Gjoll, River of the Dead'
* LOD issues can be observed with Loki preceding the IGC for 'More Than You Can Chew' in 'Tavern'
* Difficulty is reset after the user changes the setting and reloads the last checkpoint during the final boss fight
* User is unable to verify their HP status during Boss fights throughout the title
* Performance drops when the user progressively reaches 150 kills and beyond in any arena
* Follower icons required for 'Hidden Stash' side quest are absent when opening the quest in the 'Quest Book' at 'The Virgin's Labyrinth'
* 'Secret Of The Old Keep' follower required is absent when opening the quest through the 'Quest Book' menu in 'The Old Keep'
* Crushing SFX is played when switching from Rognvald to God in 'Aegir's Hall'
* 'Flame To Riches' sidequest objective fails to complete when the user is slain by fire traps and reloads at the 'Scorched Hallway Entrance' checkpoint in 'Forgotten Sanctum'
* Z-fighting occurs on wall in the 'Butcher's Table' arena
* User is able to acquire the 'Feats of Strength' application achievement before completing the 'Feats of Strength' Quest in the 'Valley of Trials'
* Haptic feedback persists when opening the in-game menu while on a moving elevator throughout the title
* Wet and cracked floor decals show flickering and z-fighting at 'Great Chamber' and 'Rotunda' checkpoints of 'The Great Belfry'
* Z-fighting observed on path between user and Thor during final sequence of 'Skadi's Island'
* After transforming a frog into 'Siggi', he will disappear and reappear when quitting and reloading the title at the 'River Isle' checkpoint in 'Gjoll, River of the Dead'
* Environmental assets fail to load when reloading from an autosave checkpoint and backtracking to the beginning of the level in the 'Dark Passage'
* Assets disappear when backtracking after opening door to 'Hidden Tomb' in 'Unmarked Tomb'
* The arrow indicator is absent when tracking the 'Herbal' quest at 'Chamber Of Deceit' checkpoint in 'Hvergelmir Passage' 
* SFX and VFX are inconsistent for HP status when 'Player HUD' is turned 'OFF' throughout the title
* Progression blocker occurs when entering god mode after clicking 'Proceed' for the 'Frenzy Mead' tutorial in 'Borgarholt Fort'
* User falls off the critical path when standing on the elevator leading to 'Guard's Wing' checkpoint in 'Skadi's Island'
* Often, god gender changes when holding onto the Fool Stone when finishing the 'KrakenBossFight'

Note - you'll need a large amount of free drive space to install this. This is because of how updates work on the Oculus desktop app and is out of our control.

Fixed Bugs:
Various optimizations.
God speed will now respect the general speed setting that’s already in the menu.  That setting was previously only changing the mortal speed.
'Ransacking' side quest objective fails to complete when reloading the title after activating the 'Hidden Tomb' checkpoint in 'The Unmarked Tomb'
Application's icon is cut-off on the Oculus Dash
RX580/RTX2080ti performance optimizations, especially on the Saga 2 Village location.
Enemies fail to spawn when the user approaches revitalized area near the Deathly Traps checkpoint in The Halls Of The Dead
Lighting on Female God's hair, eyebrows and eyelashes are corrupted and not consistent with Male God's at gender selection screen
Application is stuck in the front-end screen when initiating gameplay on Rift S using an RX580/GTX1060
Assets fail to load in 'Dragon's Den' sidequest area when walking from 'End of the Line' sidequest area in 'Borgaholt Fort'
Assets fail to load when backtracking to 'End of the Line' sidequest area
'Enemy Rage' loading screen does not accurately explain the current behavior of the rage meter
Quest Detail Complete Background Not Showing
The user is able to acquire two ancient swords when throwing one at an enemy during combat throughout the title
User falls when taking chain lift down at 'Tomb Of The Thorketill The Patient' checkpoint in 'Stormborn Beach'
Ingrid's lever handle acquisition VO nag line repeats when user opens third door and reloads at the 'Tomb of Odd the Brave'
Fixed bug where sometimes the player was unable to progress or switch back to god until relaunching.
Correct practice sword label from displaying persistently.
Adjust map travel dialog to obscure less of Loki.
Remove button selection when the scrolling list isn’t available.
Adjusted color offsets in the favor arena and Hel boss battle.
Frenzy audio cue is triggered during follower selection in the crafting upgrades Menu in Tavern
Tyr's weapon is floating in mid-air after the user defeated him in ''Borgarholt Village''
Battle Music is played indefinitely when the user interacts with the totem pieces for a certain amount of time in god mode in 'Gjoll, River of the Dead'
Sometimes, user experiences elevation when walking on target dummy's arms in 'CombatTutorial_01'
Midgard Faerie blessing does not trigger when consuming potions throughout the title
Placeholder Characters Still Visible in Hint Avenged Notifications
Rift S controllers displayed within the 'Controls' Section of the 'General Combat' tutorial book on Rift
Camera position snaps back when the User experiences camera shaking throughout the title
User can become stuck when walking against sides of an Egil platform while it raises or lowers in 'Stormborn Beach'
User is unable to complete 'Darkness Below' when 'Steinar' loses the ability to interact with one of the blocks in 'Stormborn Beach'
Progression blocks when standing on the lever platform and completing the hammerstone puzzle at the 'Holding Chamber' checkpoint in 'Skadi's Island'
User is blocked and stuck when walking close to the snail shell in the stairs to the side quest 'What Lies Below' in 'Valley of the Jotnar'
The application fails to acknowledge Hel's Saboteur's death when caused by burn status ailment throughout the title
User is able to explore area underneath the turbine elevator and fall OOW during the 'High and Dry' side quest in 'Tombs of the Brotherhood'
Sluice pipes may overlap when allowing one of the same segment to respawn on an already occupied slot in the puzzle in 'Hvergelmir Passage'
Stikkan's VO can be heard before loading into the level throughout 'Gjoll, River of the Dead'
SFX and VFX are inconsistent for HP status when 'Player HUD' is turned 'OFF' throughout the title
 
New Features
Add advanced graphics settings menu
Add point to steer control in settings
After enough deaths the difficulty options and descriptions are displayed.

COMBAT
•	Remove rage meter reset after parry miss. Deduct rage incrementally. Follower attacks on stunned enemies adhere to the same rules.
     •	     Rank 1 – deduct .25 of the rage meter.
     •	     Rank 2 – deduct .25 of the rage meter.
     •	     Rank 3 – deduct .25 of the rage meter.
     •	     Rank 4 – deduct .50 of the rage meter.
     •	     Rank 5 – deduct .50 of the rage meter.
•	Add small, incremental amounts of rage to enemy meters using all attacks.
•	Update followers to not interfere/interrupt enemy signature and lethal attacks.
•	Update owl follower super attack to stun enemies for a shorter amount of time.
•	Update enemies with lower health to enrage faster.
•	Update mortal and legendary difficulties with less frequent shield bashing.

INVENTORY
•	Remove ability to sell preorder Valkyrie gear.

CONTROLS
•	Correct mortal scale & god scale to be consistent with head facing movement off.
•	Update bow engagement to eliminate bow juggling.

UI/HUD
•	Display the numerical value alongside/within the resolution slider.
•	Correct weapon status to not display in no HUD/immersive mode.
•	Add character icons in the quest log for the End of the Line quest.
•	After x amount of deaths, display wrath difficulty options and descriptions.

AUDIO
•	Update default volume to be 85% versus 50%.
"Automated Sanzaru Build - For internal testing only. Date: 2019-07-16"
